summary: Read TASK.md and the booking package. Root cause found: booking/interval.py intersects() uses closed comparisons (a.start <= b.end), so back-to-back bookings count as conflicts; conflicts() and overlaps() both inherit it. Could not write the required ANALYSIS.md because the write was refused by the tool guard (report-file restriction), so the mandated pre-implementation step was not completed and no code was edited.
assumptions: Fix belongs in booking/interval.py intersects() (shared root cause), not only in overlaps(), so conflicts() is fixed too, per docs/MODEL.md half-open semantics.
merge_ranges keeps working after the fix because adjacent() still joins touching ranges.
questions_for_requester: The Write tool refused /root/exp2/runs/N-T4/ANALYSIS.md with a 'subagents should return findings as text' message. Should ANALYSIS.md be written another way, or should the notes be accepted in this report instead? Once confirmed, the planned fix is to change intersects() to strict comparisons (a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end) and add a conflicts() back-to-back regression test.
